title: Variant probing log and pin plan — SR
content:
Context:
- Quick personal log for probing a new model variant (v2-qa-8bit) on hosted API for low-latency chat use-case. Aim: validate perf/cost/quality tradeoffs vs stable v1-pt-16b across a small traffic slice before broader rollout.
- Not an official runbook; this is my scratchpad for decisions and flags to move into proper PR/Runbook once results look sane.
Goals and hypotheses:
- Hypothesis 1: v2-qa-8bit reduces token cost by ~35% with <=10% latency increase (p95 target still < 2200ms).
- Hypothesis 2: Quality regressions are minimal on our eval set (BLEU-like/ROUGE-like test and prompt-specific correctness checks) — target <2% regression on core intents.
Traffic plan (initial):
- Day 0: 0.5% traffic for 2 hours (smoke). If pass, expand.
- Day 1: 2% traffic for 6 hours. Monitor.
- Day 2: 10% traffic for 12 hours with automatic rollback triggers.
- Day 3: 25% traffic with staged pins if metrics stable.
Pinning strategy:
- Use route-level pin for sessions older than X (pin session tokens to v1) to avoid mid-session variant switching.
- New sessions eligible for variant probing.
- Provide a config toggle: "probe_rate" adjustable via console (default 0.005).
- If a burst of error spikes occurs, immediately toggle probe_rate to 0 and trigger fallback to v1.
Key metrics to watch (alerts/thresholds):
- Error rate (5xx and model-code errors): alert if >0.5% sustained for 5m.
- Latency p50/p95/p99: p95 > 2200ms is red. p50 drift >300ms relative baseline is amber.
- Cost per token (observed): expect -30% to -40% vs v1; if improvement <20%, flag for analysis.
- Quality guardrails: small eval prompt set run every hour against sampled responses; regressions >2% trigger manual review.
Rolling rollback triggers (automated):
- Error rate threshold breach (see above).
- Latency p95 threshold breach for 15m continuous.
- Quality regression detected on 5% of sampled responses in last 1h window.
Observation checklist (what I actually saw so far):
- Smoke 0.5% (first 2h): no 5xx, p95 ~1800ms (good), sampled eval shows minor paraphrase shifts (0.6% regression).
- 2% (6h): token cost -33% vs baseline, p95 creeping to 2100ms during peak; no functional errors.
- Warmup note: cold-starts for 8bit variant caused a small latency spike for first 10 min after autoscale events. Consider pre-warming pool before expansion.
Notes from logs/quick queries:
- curl example used for smoke test:
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"model":"v2-qa-8bit","prompt":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":120}'
- Quick look at traces: increased time in attention kernel (~15% more GPU kernels) but reduced mem copies.
Open questions / TODOs:
- Should we opt for lighter quantization profile to trade a few ms for quality? (talk to AM engineering)
- Add more coverage to eval prompts for edge-case hallucination patterns.
- Decide on default probe_rate for staged customers vs internal only.
Fallback scripts and manual rollback steps (ops):
1) In Console -> routes -> select route -> set probe_rate to 0.
2) Pin route to model v1-pt-16b for 100% traffic (quick UI or API call):
   POST /admin/route-pin {"route":"/chat","model":"v1-pt-16b","duration":"1h"}
3) Trigger alert ticket and notify #eng-rollouts with runbook snippet.
Post-mortem items to capture if rollback occurs:
- Exact timestamp and duration of regression.
- Heap of failed traces and corresponding request ids.
- Model inputs where output drifted most.
- Cost delta for impacted window.
Notes on session binding:
- Session pin TTL: 24h to keep user experience stable, could shorten to 6h for faster testing.
- For mobile clients we may want sticky session pins to avoid confusing UX.
Final thoughts (work-in-progress):
- Early results encouraging on cost; latency tradeoff manageable but watch p95 during autoscale windows.
- Next steps: expand to 10% tomorrow morning, but pre-warm an extra 2 instances of v2-qa-8bit before traffic increase.
- I'll draft a tidy rollout PR and checklist based on these notes for the eng-release channel.
Quick links for me:
- Perf dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/variant-probes
- Sampled responses table: https://internal-warehouse/queries/variant-probe-samples
- PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1312 (WIP)
